name: Ancient Spirit
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Felwood was once a peaceful and serene land... Until the legion took hold. The infernals, destruction, chaos...

The skull of Gul'dan ensured that none were spared here. All fell to the corruption.

Even now, as a spirit, I still find myself trapped, bearing the suffering of this land. Help me find my way home. Please, adventurer, tell me you will lead an ancient spirit away from here, where I may finally rest.

Once I am free, seek out Kayneth Stillwind, a druid that resides in Forest Song, to the east.
narrative.objectives: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, adventurer. Felwood has been through much hardship. Thank you for what you have done.

One day, we may be able to reclaim Felwood from the corruption; every kind deed helps.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 54 to 56, 23,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Flute of Xavaric
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Flute of Xavaric and 5 Jadefire Felbind samples to Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Felbound Ancients
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon.

quests.name: Purified!
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

quests.objectiveText: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.
